subject: Capacity amnesty & tier smoothing for launch week
messages:
From: Sarah Lopez <sarah@clearline.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearline.ai
Date: 2026-07-11T09:12:00Z
Subject: Unexpected throttle during launch — request for temporary uplift and billing ask

Hi Neha,

Quick note from launch week — we hit a spike yesterday (peak 420 requests/s against our quota) and several pipelines were throttled. The engineering team says our integration is within expected patterns, but traffic was higher than forecasted. We consumed ~2.2M tokens in a 4-hour window.

Two asks: can you do a short-term rate-limit bump (24–72 hours) to avoid more throttles while we scale? Second, we're seeing an overrun on last month's invoice; procurement is asking whether Redwood can offer a one-time concession on the surge surcharge while we finalize a longer commit.

I attached a usage export and screenshots. If needed, procurement (cc'd) can take a formal scoping call. Appreciate any quick help.

Thanks,
Sarah Lopez
Director of Engineering — Clearline AI
attachments: Clearline_usage_q2.csv (CSV export, 42KB), launch_spike_screens.png (PNG, 1.2MB)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lopez <sarah@clearline.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, procurement@clearline.ai
Date: 2026-07-11T12:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Unexpected throttle during launch — request for temporary uplift and billing ask

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the heads up and for sending the exports. I pulled the logs — that 4-hour window lines up with a short-lived campaign hit; I can authorize a temporary soft-lift immediately. Proposed path:

- Immediate: open a 72-hour provisional rate-lift to 600 req/s for your account to prevent further throttling (no code change needed).
- Billing: we can apply an \"amnesty\" on surge surcharge for the portion up to a 25% uplift over committed quota if you accept a 6-month staged commit (details below). Any usage beyond that capped uplift would be billed at 50% of standard overrun rate (blended).
- Next steps: we'll draft a one-page amendment (terms + dates) for signature. If procurement wants a deeper discount, Jordan can run numbers for a 12-month commit.

I've looped in Jordan (AE) to confirm commercial options and Rachel (CS) to coordinate the immediate rate-lift and monitoring. Attached: draft amnesty terms (v1) and I asked billing to pre-check impact.

If that works, say yes and I will trigger the 72-hour lift now.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0199
attachments: Clearline_amnesty_terms_v1.docx (docx, 18KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lopez <sarah@clearline.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, procurement@clearline.ai
Date: 2026-07-11T14:37:00Z
Subject: Re: Capacity amnesty & tier smoothing for launch week

Sarah — quick note from my side: happy to model the economics for either a 6- or 12-month commit. High-level options (ballpark):

A) 6-month staged commit: 10% platform discount + the 25% uplift amnesty Neha mentioned; blended overrun rate at 50% of standard.
B) 12-month commit: 15% platform discount + 40% uplift amnesty; overrun billed at 25% of standard.

I'll run exact figures against last 3 months of usage and share in a follow-up. If procurement wants to move quickly, I can prepare an addendum and pricing sheet for electronic signature.

-Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Lopez <sarah@clearline.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearline.ai, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T08:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Capacity amnesty & tier smoothing for launch week

Thanks, Neha and Jordan — that path sounds reasonable and fast. Procurement prefers the 6-month path to avoid long-term lock. Two points:

1) Need clarity on invoice timing — will the amnesty show as a credit on next invoice, or as an adjustment?
2) Can the provisional 72-hour lift be extended if we see a second spike while we sign the amendment? We may need an extra 48 hours depending on campaign cadence.

Procurement (procurement@clearline.ai) will review the docx and get back with any redlines. We can sign by EOD Friday if terms match the outline.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Sarah
